During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Land assault trooper|Imperial Army assault troopers]] '''attacked''' a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obas]] as the latter was attempting to prevent the destruction of an [[Obas base|Alliance base]] there.<ref name="Meltdown" />
